reviews.text: May God always bless your work! Thank you for doing your best for my dog, who is sadly no longer here!

Good afternoon, I took my cat for a consultation, had a blood test done, and they gave me a form to contact to get the results. I've been waiting for a week for the test results and there are no other available appointments. The service is slow, I found the doctors very good, but there's this problem with follow-up appointments. You need to change your policy regarding tests. I live far away and I'll have to take a day off work to go get this test done, or will you check WhatsApp and respond as you instruct? My cat is sick and I'm waiting in line to see the ophthalmologist. The advertising is great, we have a public veterinary hospital, but it's chaotic. It needs a lot of improvement!!

This place is garbage! They denied an emergency and my cat DIED! If the state she arrived in wasn't an emergency, what is an emergency to you?
Don't waste your time taking your pets to this place if you don't want to see your little animal suffer from the neglect of those who swore to care for and help animals. Here is my indignation and outrage! A defenseless being needed help! Writing here won't do any good, I know, but maybe I can prevent other instances of negligence from happening.
Extremely slow. Too much customer service. Super stressful.
Crowded but the service was very good, the staff's politeness is admirable.

Even though it was a public place, with its limited resources, my little dog Jorge Luis received the best treatment! I want to thank the entire triage team for their love, care, and empathy. Medical Clinic, Surgeons, the vets at the PSA. The guys who control access, the cleaning ladies, the short-haired girl at reception!! Thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️ May God bless you all abundantly. He is at rest! And you were the best ❣️❤️
